text: Na década dos anos 60, regresou a unha Alxeria que acababa de acadar a independencia para ensinar dirección cinematográfica.
eng_text: In the 1960s he headed back to newly-independent Algeria to teach film directing.

text: O judoka xaponés, Hitoshi Saito, gañador de dúas medallas de ouro olímpicas, faleceu á idade de 54 anos.
eng_text: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.

text: A causa da morte comunicouse como cancro do conduto biliar intrahepático.
eng_text: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

text: Faleceu o martes en Osaka.
eng_text: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.

text: Ademais de ser excampión mundial e olímpico, Saito era presidente do comité de adestramento da Federación xaponesa de judo no momento da súa morte.
eng_text: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

text: Preto de 100 persoas acudiron á festa de celebración do primeiro aniversario dunha parella que celebrou o seu casamento o ano anterior.
eng_text: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.

text: Programouse unha celebración oficial do aniversario para unha data posterior, segundo fontes oficiais.
eng_text: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.

text: A parella casara en Texas había un ano e diríxase a Buffalo para celebralo con amigos e parentes.
eng_text: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.

text: O marido, de 30 anos de idade, nado en Buffalo, foi un dos catro falecidos no tiroteo, aínda que a súa muller non sufriu lesións.
eng_text: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.

text: Karno é un famoso aínda que controvertido titor inglés que exerceu en Modern Education e King's Glory e afirmou chegar a ter 9000 estudantes no momento álxido da súa carreira.
eng_text: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

text: Nas súas notas empregaba palabras que algúns pais consideraban groseiras e, presuntamente, blasfemaba na aula.
eng_text: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

text: Modern Education acusouno de imprimir anuncios de gran tamaño nos autobuses sen estar autorizado e de mentir ao dicir que era o titor titular de inglés.
eng_text: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

text: Tamén foi acusado previamente de violación dos dereitos de autor, pero non se presentaron cargos contra el.
eng_text: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

text: Un antigo estudante afirmou que «usaba xerga nas clases, nos apuntamentos ensinaba habilidades para facer as beiras e era máis ben un amigo para os estudantes».
eng_text: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

text: Nas tres últimas décadas, aínda que continúa sendo un estado comunista, China aplicou a economía de mercado.
eng_text: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: As primeiras reformas económicas realizáronse baixo o liderado de Deng Xiaoping.
eng_text: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: Desde entón, o tamaño da economía chinesa multiplicouse por 90.
eng_text: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text: Por primeira vez, o último pasado China exportou máis coches que Alemaña e adiantou aos EUA como o mercado máis grande deste sector.
eng_text: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: O PIB da China podería superar o dos EE. UU. en menos de dúas décadas.
eng_text: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: A tormenta tropical Danielle, que é xa a cuarta treboada á que se lle pon nome na temporada de furacáns do Atlántico no 2010, formouse ao leste do océano Atlántico.
eng_text: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: A tormenta, situada a aproximadamente 3000 millas de Miami (Florida), presentou ventos sostidos con velocidades máximas de 40 mph (64 kph).
eng_text: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: Os científicos do National Hurricane Center prevén que Danielle acadará forza de furacán o vindeiro mércores.
eng_text: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Posto que a tormenta está lonxe de chegar a terra, resulta difícil avaliar o seu impacto potencial nos EE. UU. ou no Caribe.
eng_text: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Nado na capital de Croacia, Zagreb, Bobek acadou sona xogando para o Partizan Belgrade.
eng_text: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: Uniuse a eles en 1945 e permaneceu ata 1958.
eng_text: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

text: Durante o tempo que estivo no equipo, marcou 403 goles en 468 intervencións.
eng_text: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

text: Ningún outro xogador tivo máis participacións nin marcou máis goles para o club que Bobek.
eng_text: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: En 1995, foi votado como o mellor xogador na historia do Partizan.
eng_text: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

text: As celebracións comezaron cun espectáculo especial do mundialmente famoso grupo Circo do Sol.
eng_text: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: A continuación, tocou a Orquestra Sinfónica Estatal de Istambul, un grupo xanízaro e os cantantes Fatih Erkoç e Müslüm Gürses.
eng_text: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text: Whirling Dervishes subiu deseguido ao escenario.
eng_text: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text: A diva turca Sezen Aksu actuou co tenor italiano Alessandro Safina e a cantante grega Haris Alexiou.
eng_text: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: Para rematar, o grupo de baile turco Fire of Anatolia representou o espectáculo "Troia".
eng_text: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Peter Lenz, un piloto de moto de 13 anos, faleceu despois de verse implicado nunha colisión no Indianapolis Motor Speedway.
eng_text: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Mentres realizaba a volta de quecemento, Lenz caeu da bicicleta e foi atropelado polo seu compañeiro de carreira, Xavier Zayat.
eng_text: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: Foi atendido de inmediato polo persoal médico na pista e transportado a un hospital local onde posteriormente faleceu.
eng_text: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Zayat saíu ileso do accidente.
eng_text: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Con relación á situación económica global, Zapatero engadiu que "o sistema financeiro formar parte da economía e é esencial.
eng_text: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Temos unha crise financeira dun ano de duración, que atravesou o seu momento máis delicado no último par de meses e penso que agora os mercados financeiros empezan a recuperarse».
eng_text: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: A semana pasada, Naked news anunciou que incrementaría considerablemente o seu mandado internacional de idiomas no seu labor periodístico con tres novas emisións.
eng_text: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: A organización global, que xa fai actualmente as súas retransmisións en inglés e xaponés, lanza agora a súa programación para televisión, web e dispositivos móbiles en español, italiano e coreano.
eng_text: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: «Por sorte, non me pasou nada, pero presenciei unha escena macabra, con xente intentando romper as ventás para saír.
eng_text: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Os pasaxeiros golpeaban os cristais coas cadeiras, pero as ventás eran irrompibles.
eng_text: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: Un dos paneis acabou por romper e comezaron a saír pola ventá», afirmou o supervivente Franciszek Kowal.
eng_text: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: As estrelas emiten suficiente luz e calor debido á enerxía xerada na combinación dos átomos de hidróxeno (ou fusión) para formar elementos máis pesados.
eng_text: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Os científicos traballan para crear un reactor que poida xerar enerxía do mesmo xeito.
eng_text: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Non obstante, iso supón un problema moi difícil de resolver e será necesario que pasen moitos anos antes de que presenciemos a construción de reactores de fusión útiles.
eng_text: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: A agulla de aceiro flota sobre a auga debido a tensión xerada na superficie.
eng_text: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: A tensión superficial prodúcese porque as moléculas de auga na superficie da auga teñen unha forte atracción entre si superior á que teñen coas moléculas do aire sobre elas.
eng_text: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: As moléculas de auga crean unha película invisible sobre a superficie da auga que permite que obxectos como a agulla floten sobre ela.
eng_text: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: A coitela nun patín de esquí sobre xeo moderno ten un fío dobre cun oco cóncavo entre cada un. Ambos os dous fíos permiten un mellor agarre ao xeo, mesmo en posición inclinada.
eng_text: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Como a parte inferior da coitela é lixeiramente curva, a medida esta se inclina cara a un lado ou a outro, o bordo en contacto co xeo tamén se curva.
eng_text: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Isto fai que o esquiador vire. Se os esquís se inclinan cara á dereita, o esquiador vira cara á dereita; se os esquís se inclinan cara á esquerda, o esquiador vira cara á esquerda.
eng_text: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Para recuperar o seu nivel de enerxía previo, teñen que eliminar a enerxía extra que captaron da luz.
eng_text: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Para tal fin, emiten unha minúscula partícula de luz chamada "fotón".
eng_text: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Os científicos denominan este proceso "emisión estimulada de radiación", porque os átomos son estimulados pola luz brillante, o que xera a emisión dun fotón de luz, e a luz é un tipo de radiación.
eng_text: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Na seguinte imaxe vense os átomos emitindo fotóns. Por suposto, en realidade os fotóns son moito máis pequenos que os que se ven aí.
eng_text: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Os fotóns son aínda máis pequenos que as partículas que compoñen os átomos!
eng_text: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Transcorridos centos de horas de funcionamento, o filamento da lámpada finalmente quéimase e a lámpada deixa de funcionar.
eng_text: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Entón cómpre cambiar a lámpada. Débese poñer coidado ao substituíla.
eng_text: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: En primeiro lugar, cómpre apagar ou desconectar o cable do interruptor da lámpada.
eng_text: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Isto acontece porque a electricidade que entra no enchufe onde se atopa a sección metálica da lámpada pode provocar unha descarga eléctrica grave se se toca o interior do enchufe ou da base de metal da lámpada cando está aínda introducida en parte no enchufe.
eng_text: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: O principal órgano do sistema circulatorio é o corazón, que bombea o sangue.
eng_text: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: O sangue sae do corazón a través de tubos chamados arterias e regresa por outros chamados veas. Os de menor tamaño chámanse capilares.
eng_text: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Os dentes dos tricerátops serían capaces de esmagar non só as follas, senón tamén pólas e raíces moi duras.
eng_text: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Algúns científicos pensan que os tricerátops comían cícadas, un tipo de planta que era moi común no cretáceo.
eng_text: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Estas plantas parecen pequenas palmeiras cunha coroa de follas cortantes e agudas.
eng_text: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Un tricerátops ben podería usar o seu resistente peteiro para arrincar as follas antes de comer o tronco.
eng_text: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Outros científicos argumentan que estas plantas eran moi velenosas, polo que era improbable que ningún dinosauro as comese, aínda que hoxe en día os preguiceiros e outros animais coma o loro (un descendente dos dinosauros) poden comer follas e froitas velenosas.
eng_text: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Cal sería o pulo da gravidade de Io sobre o noso corpo? Se nos pousásemos sobre a superficie de Io, pesariamos menos do que na Terra?
eng_text: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Unha persoa que pesa 90 kg (200 libras) na Terra pesaría 16 kg (36 libras) en Io. Polo que a gravidade, por suposto, ten menor tracción sobre os corpos.
eng_text: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: O Sol non ten cortiza como a Terra sobre que se poder pousar. O Sol está composto de gases, lume e plasma.
eng_text: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: O gas faise menos denso a medida que nos afastamos do centro do Sol.
eng_text: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: A parte externa que se ve ao mirar o Sol chámase fotosfera, que significa «bóla de luz».
eng_text: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Case tres mil anos despois, no 1610, o astrónomo italiano Galileo Galilei empregou un telescopio para observar que Venus ten fases, exactamente igual que a Lúa.
eng_text: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: As fases prodúcense porque só o lado de Venus (ou da Lúa) que dá cara ao Sol está iluminada. As fases de Venus sustentaron a teoría de Copérnico de que os planetas xiran arredor do Sol.
eng_text: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Posteriormente, uns anos despois, en 1639, un astrónomo inglés chamado Jeremiah Horrocks observou o tránsito de Venus.
eng_text: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Inglaterra viviu un período de paz duradeiro despois da reconquista de Danelaw.
eng_text: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Contodo, en 991 Ethelred loitou contra unha frota viquinga máis grande ca ningunha outra desde a de Guthrum un século atrás.
eng_text: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Esta frota ía liderada por Olaf Trygvasson, un noruegués coa ambición de recuperar o seu país do xugo danés.
eng_text: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Despois duns contratempos militares iniciais, Ethelred logrou chegar a un acordo con Olaf, que retornou a Noruega para tratar de recuperar o seu reino con relativo éxito.
eng_text: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: O hangeul é o único alfabeto inventado ex profeso que aínda se usa habitualmente a diario. Este alfabeto foi creado en 1444 durante o reinado do rei Sejong (1418 – 1450).
eng_text: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: King Sejong foi o cuarto rei da dinastía Joseon e un dos máis queridos.
eng_text: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Inicialmente, denominou o alfabeto hangeul como Hunmin Jeongeum, que significa "os sons correctos para a educación do pobo".
eng_text: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Existen numerosas teorías sobre como xurdiu o sánscrito. Unha delas fai referencia á migración dos arios desde o oeste da India, que levaron o seu idioma consigo.
eng_text: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: O sánscrito é unha lingua antiga que se podería comparar co latín que se falaba en Europa.
eng_text: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: O primeiro libro coñecido do mundo estaba escrito en sánscrito. Despois da compilación de Upanishads, o sánscrito desapareceu por causa da xerarquía.
eng_text: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: O sánscrito é unha lingua complexa e moi rica, que se empregou como base de diversas linguas indias modernas, igual que o Latín é a base de linguas europeas como poden ser o francés e o castelán.
eng_text: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Unha vez gañada a loita para facerse con Francia, Alemaña empezou a se preparar para a invasión da illa de Gran Bretaña.
eng_text: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Alemaña púxolle de nome clave ao ataque «Operación León Mariño». A maioría das armas pesadas e subministracións da Armada Británica perdéranse durante a evacuación de Dunkirk, polo que estaba bastante debilitada.
eng_text: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Non obstante, a Armada Real británica («Royal Navy») segue sendo moito máis forte que a armada alemá («Kriegsmarine») e podería destruír calquera frota invasora enviada polo Canal da Mancha.
eng_text: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Con todo, moi poucos barcos da Armada Británica tiñan a súa base preto das probables rutas de invasión, posto que os almirantes tiñan medo de que os afundisen os ataques aéreos alemáns.
eng_text: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Empecemos explicando os plans de Italia. Italia era sobre todo o "irmán pequeno" de Alemaña e Xapón.
eng_text: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Contaba cun exército e unha armada máis débil, aínda que acababan de construír catro barcos novos xusto antes do inicio da guerra.
eng_text: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Os seus obxectivos principais eran os países de África. Para conquistar eses países, precisaban dunha plataforma de lanzamento para as tropas, de xeito que estas puidesen chegar polo mar Mediterráneo e invadir África.
eng_text: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Para iso, precisaban desfacerse das bases británicas e dos barcos en Exipto. Ademais desas accións, supoñíase que os acoirazados italianos non debían facer nada máis.
eng_text: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Agora o Xapón. O Xapón era un país insular, igual que Gran Bretaña.
eng_text: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Os submarinos son barcos deseñados para viaxar por debaixo da auga onde poden permanecer durante períodos de tempo prolongados.
eng_text: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Os submarinos usáronse na Primeira e na Segunda Guerra Mundial. Daquela eran moi lentos e tiñan un alcance de tiro moi limitado.
eng_text: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Ao comezo da guerra desprazábanse fundamentalmente por enriba do mar, pero a medida que o radar comezou a perfeccionarse e ser máis preciso, os submarinos víronse obrigados a ir por debaixo da auga para evitar seren vistos.
eng_text: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Os submarinos alemáns chamábanse U-Boats. Os alemáns eran moi bos pilotando e operando os seus submarinos.
eng_text: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Como consecuencia do éxito que tiñan cos submarinos, despois da guerra non se permitiu que os alemáns posuísen moitos.
eng_text: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: En efecto! O rei Tutankamón, ás veces coñecido tamén como o «rei Tut» ou o «rei neno», é un dos antigos reis exipcios mellor coñecidos na época moderna.
eng_text: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Curiosamente, na antigüidade non estaba considerado como un personaxe importante e non aparece incluído na maioría das listaxes de reis antigos.
eng_text: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Non obstante, o descubrimento da súa tumba no 1922 fíxoo famoso. Mentres que moitas tumbas do pasado foran espoliadas, esta quedou practicamente intacta.
eng_text: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: A maioría dos obxectos que se enterraron con Tutankamón están moi ben conservados, incluídos os milleiros de artefactos feitos con metais preciosos e pedras raras.
eng_text: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: A invención das rodas de radios fixo que os carros de combate dos asirios fosen máis lixeiros rápidos e estivesen mellor preparados para adiantar aos soldados e outros carros.
eng_text: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: As frechas dos seus mortíferos arcos lograban penetrar a armadura dos soldados inimigos. Cerca do 1000 a. C., os asirios introduciron a primeira cabalería.
eng_text: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: A cabalaría é un exército que loita a cabalo. A sela aínda non se inventara, polo que a cabalaría asiria loitaba sobre o lombo espido dos seus cabalos.
eng_text: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Agora sabemos de diferentes políticos, científicos e artistas gregos. É posible que o autor de máis sona desta cultura é Homero, o lendario poeta cego, que escribiu dúas obras clásicas da literatura grega: os poemas da Ilíada e a Odisea.
eng_text: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sófocles e Aristófanes aínda continúan a ser dramaturgos populares e as súas obras están consideradas unhas das mellores da literatura mundial.
eng_text: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Outro grego famoso é o matemático Pitágoras, famoso fundamentalmente polo seu sonado teorema sobre a relación entre os lados dos triángulos rectángulos.
eng_text: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Os cálculos do número de falantes do hindi varían. Estímase que se atopa entre a segunda e a cuarta lingua máis falada do mundo.
eng_text: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: O número de falantes nativos varía dependendo de se se contan os dialectos moi próximos.
eng_text: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Os cálculos oscilan entre 340 e 500 millóns de falantes e case 800 millóns de persoas que poden entender o idioma.
eng_text: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: O hindi e o urdú teñen un vocabulario parecido, pero a escrita é diferente; nas conversas diarias, os falantes de ambas as dúas linguas poden entenderse entre si.
eng_text: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Arredor do século XV, o norte de Estonia atopábase baixo unha intensa influencia cultural de Alemaña.
eng_text: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Algúns monxes alemáns querían acercar a Deus aos habitantes locais, por iso inventaron a lingua literal estonia.
eng_text: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Baseábase no alfabeto alemán e engadíuselle o carácter "Õ/õ".
eng_text: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Co paso do tempo, moitas palabras tomadas en empréstito do alemán acabaron fusionándose. Este foi o comezo da iluminación.
eng_text: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: O habitual era que o herdeiro do trono entrase directamente no exército ao rematar a escola.
eng_text: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Non obstante, Charles foi á universidade no Trinity College (Cambridge) onde estudou antropoloxía e arqueoloxía e, posteriormente, historia na que obtivo unha cualificación de 2:2 (grao baixo de segunda clase).
eng_text: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles foi o primeiro membro da familia real británica que obtivo un título universitario.
eng_text: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: A Turquía europea (Tracia oriental ou Rumelia na península dos Balcáns) inclúe un 3 % do país.
eng_text: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: O territorio de Turquía supera os 1600 quilómetros (1000 millas) de longo e 800 km (500 millas) de ancho, e presenta unha forma máis ou menos rectangular.
eng_text: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: A superficie de Turquía, incluíndo lagos, abarca 783 562 km2 (300 948 sq mi), dos que 755 688 km2 (291,773 sq mi) están no suroeste de Asia e 23 764 km2 (9,174 sq mi) en Europa.
eng_text: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: A superficie de Turquía fai dela o 37.º país máis grande do mundo e equivale á extensión metropolitana de Francia e do Reino Unido xuntos.
eng_text: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turquía está arrodeado de mar polos tres costados: o mar Exeo ao oeste, o mar Negro ao norte e o mar Mediterráneo ao sur.
eng_text: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luxemburgo ten unha dilatada historia, pero a súa independencia só se produciu no 1839.
eng_text: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Zonas da Bélxica actual foron parte de Luxemburgo no pasado, pero pasaron a ser deste país despois da Revolución belga de 1830.
eng_text: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luxemburgo sempre tratou de manterse como país neutral, pero foi ocupado por Alemaña tanto durante a Primeira Guerra Mundial coma durante a Segunda.
eng_text: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: En 1957, Luxemburgo converteuse nun membro fundador da organización que hoxe en día se coñece como Unión Europea.
eng_text: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong é unha fortaleza en ruínas e un mosteiro budista na parte alta do distrito de Paro (en Phondey Village).
eng_text: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Pénsase que en 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel creou a fortaleza para conmemorar a súa vitoria contra as forzas tibetanas e mongois.
eng_text: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: En 1951, produciuse un incendio do que só se salvaron algunhas das reliquias de Drukgyal Dzong, como a imaxe de Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
eng_text: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Despois do incendio, a fortaleza conservouse e protexeuse, converténdose nunha das atraccións máis atraentes de Bután.
eng_text: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Durante o século XVIII, Camboxa encontrouse atrapada entre dous poderosos veciños: Tailandia e Vietnam.
eng_text: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Os thais invadiron Camboxa en numerosas ocasións no século XVIII e no 1772 destruíron Phnom Phen.
eng_text: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Nos últimos anos do século XVIII, os vietnamitas tamén invadiron Camboxa.
eng_text: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Un 18 % dos venezolanos están no paro e a maioría dos que traballan fano na economía somerxida.
eng_text: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Dous terzos dos venezolanos que traballan fano no sector servizos, case un cuarto traballan no sector industrial e un quinto na agricultura.
eng_text: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Unha industria de relevancia para os venezolanos é o petróleo, do que o país é un exportador neto, a pesar de que só un 1 % traballa no sector petrolífero.
eng_text: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Nos primeiros momentos da independencia do país, os coñecementos do Xardín Botánico de Singapur axudaron a transformar a illa nunha cidade xardín tropical.
eng_text: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: En 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, unha orquídea híbrida, foi elixida como a flor nacional do país.
eng_text: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Todos os anos, arredor do mes de outubro, case 1,5 millóns de herbívoros avanzan cara ás chairas do sur, cruzando o río Mara, procedentes dos outeiros do norte en busca da choiva.
eng_text: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: E, despois, volta cara ao norte a través do oeste, cruzando de novo o río Mara, tras as choivas arredor do mes de abril.
eng_text: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: A rexión do Serengeti acolle o Parque Nacional do Serengeti, a Área de conservación de Ngorongoro e a Reserva animal de Maswa en Tanzania e a Reserva nacional de Maasai Mara en Kenya.
eng_text: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Aprender a crear recursos multimedia interactivos require habilidades convencionais e tradicionais, ademais de ferramentas cuxo manexo se domina en clases interactivas (storyboarding, edición de audio e vídeo, narrativa, etc.)
eng_text: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: O deseño interactivo obriga a avaliar novamente as suposicións sobre a produción de contidos multimedia e a aprender a pensar de xeito non lineal.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: O deseño interactivo require que os compoñentes dun proxecto estean conectados entre si, pero que tamén teñan sentido como entidades independentes.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: A desvantaxe dos obxectivos con amplificación por zoom é que a complexidade focal e o número de elementos da lente requiridos para acadar unha variedade de lonxitudes focais é moito maior que nos obxectivos de distancia focal fixa.
eng_text: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Isto cada vez supón un menor problema xa que os fabricantes de obxectivos acadan unha maior calidade na súa produción.
eng_text: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Isto permitiu que os obxectivos con ampliación de zoom produzan imaxes dunha calidade comparable á conseguida con obxectivos cunha distancia focal fixa.
eng_text: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Outra desvantaxe dos obxectivos con zoom é que a apertura máxima (a velocidade) do obxectivo adoita ser máis lenta.
eng_text: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Isto fai que os obxectivos con ampliación de zoom baratos resulten difíciles de usar en condicións de pouca luz sen flash.
eng_text: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Un dos problemas máis comúns ao tratar de converter unha película a formato DVD é a sobredesviación.
eng_text: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: A maioría dos televisores están fabricados para agradar ao público en xeral.
eng_text: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Por ese motivo, todo o que se ve no televisor ten os bordos superior, inferior e laterais recortados.
eng_text: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Isto faise para garantir que a imaxe abarque a totalidade da pantalla. Denomínase sobredesviación.
eng_text: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Lamentablemente, ao crear un DVD, probablemente tamén teña os bordes cortados, polo que se o vídeo ten subtítulos moi preto da parte inferior, non se verán na súa totalidade.
eng_text: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: O castelo medieval tradicional alimenta desde sempre a imaxinación, ao evocar imaxes de xustas, banquetes e cabaleiros do rei Artur.
eng_text: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Mesmo estando no medio dunhas ruínas con miles de anos de antigüidade, é fácil imaxinar os sons e olores das batallas desaparecidas, ata case escoitar o repenicar dos cascos nos lastros e cheirar o medo que sobe desde os buratos dos alxubes.
eng_text: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: A nosa imaxinación baséase na realidade? Por que razón se construíron castelos por primeira vez? Como se fixo o seu deseño e construción?
eng_text: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Característico deste período, o castelo de Kirby Muxloe é realmente máis unha casa fortificada ca un castelo como tal.
eng_text: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: As súas ventás acristaladas e finos muros non poderían resistir ningún ataque concreto durante moito tempo.
eng_text: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Na década de 1480, cando Lord Hastings iniciou a súa construción, o país atopábase nunha paz relativa e só se requiría defensa contra pequenos grupos de malandríns itinerantes.
eng_text: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: O equilibrio de poder foi un sistema mediante o que os países europeos buscaban soster a soberanía nacional de todos os estados europeos.
eng_text: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: A idea era que todas as nacións europeas debían intentar evitar que un país acaparase o poder, de xeito que os gobernos nacionais a miúdo mudaban as súas alianzas para manter o equilibrio.
eng_text: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: A Guerra de Sucesión española marcou a primeira guerra na que o eixo central era o equilibrio de poder.
eng_text: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Isto marcou un cambio importante, posto que os poderes europeos xa non tiñan o pretexto de que se trataba de guerras santas. Así, a Guerra dos Trinta Anos sería a derradeira guerra que se etiquetaría con ese nome.
eng_text: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: O templo de Artemisa no Éfeso quedou destruído o 21 de xullo do 356 a. C. nun incendio provocado por Heróstrato.
eng_text: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Conta a historia que o motivaba acadar a fama a calquera prezo. Os efesios, anoxados, anunciaron que o nome de Heróstrato endexamais se volvería mencionar.
eng_text: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: O historiador grego Estrabón máis adiante escribiu o nome, motivo polo que o coñecemos hoxe en día. O templo quedou destruído a mesma noite en que naceu Alexandre Magno.
eng_text: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexandre, na súa condición de rei, ofreceu asumir o custo de reconstruír o templo, pero a súa oferta foi rexeitada. Posteriormente, tras a morte de Alexandre, o templo reconstruíuse no 323 a. C.
eng_text: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Manteña a man o máis relaxada posible mentres toca todas as notas correctamente; intente non facer movementos demasiado esaxerados cos dedos.
eng_text: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Deste xeito, un evita cansarse o máximo posible. Débese lembrar que non é preciso premer as teclas con moita forza para acadar volume extra coma no piano.
eng_text: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: No acordeón para conseguir máis volume cómpre empregar o fol con máis presión ou velocidade.
eng_text: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: O misticismo é a busca da comuñón e da identidade cunha realidade, divindade, verdade espiritual ou Deus último, ou dunha consciencia deliberada dos mesmos.
eng_text: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: O crente busca unha experiencia directa, intuición ou visión á realidade divina/deidade ou deidades.
eng_text: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Os seguidores buscan certos estilos de vida ou prácticas que están pensadas para fomentar esas experiencias.
eng_text: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: O misticismo pode distinguirse doutras formas de crenza e veneración relixiosa polo seu énfase na experiencia persoal directa dun estado de consciencia único, particularmente os dun carácter pacífico, de comprensión, gozo ou mesmo de éxtase.
eng_text: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: O sikhismo é unha relixión presente no subcontinente indio. Ten a súa orixe na rexión do Punjab durante o século XV como resultado dunha escisión confesional da tradición hindú.
eng_text: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Os sikhs consideran a súa fe como unha relixión independente do hinduísmo, a pesar de admitiren as súas raíces e tradicións hindús.
eng_text: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: O nome co que os sikhs denominan a súa relixión é Gurmat, que en pujabi significa «o camiño do gurú». O gurú constitúe un aspecto fundamental de todas as relixións indias, pero no sikhismo adopta máis relevancia ao englobar o cerne das crenzas dos sikhs.
eng_text: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: A relixión foi fundada no século XV por Guru Nanak (1469–1539), ao que seguiron unha sucesión de nove gurús máis.
eng_text: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Con todo, en xuño de 1956, as promesas de Krushchev foron postas a proba cando as revoltas en Polonia, onde os traballadores protestaban pola a escaseza de alimentos e reducións nos salarios, se tornaron nunha protesta xeneral contra o comunismo.
eng_text: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: A pesar de que ao final, Krushchev enviou tanques para restaurar a orde, rendeuse a conceder determinadas demandas económicas e aceptou designar ao popular Wladyslaw Gomulka como primeiro ministro.
eng_text: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: A civilización do val dos Indus constituíu a civilización da Idade de Bronce no noroeste do subcontinente indio que abarca a maior parte do Paquistán da actualidade e algunhas rexión ao noroeste da India e o nordeste de Afganistán.
eng_text: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: A civilización agromou na cunca do río Indus, de onde toma o seu nome.
eng_text: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Aínda que algúns estudosos especulan con que dado que a civilización tamén existiu nas cuncas do agora seco río Sarasvati, podería denominarse correctamente como Cultura do val do Indo, mentres que algúns a etiquetan como civilización harappa en honor a Harappa, cuxo primeiro asentamento se escavou nos anos 20.
eng_text: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: A natureza militar do Imperio romano contribuíu ao desenvolvemento dos avances médicos.
eng_text: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: O emperador Augusto empezou a recrutar médicos que mesmo constituíron o primeiro corpo médico romano para o seu uso ao final das batallas.
eng_text: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Os cirurxiáns coñecían diferentes sedativos, incluída a morfina de extractos de sementes de papoula e escopolamina de sementes de meimendro.
eng_text: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Fixéronse expertos en amputacións para poder salvar da gangrena aos pacientes, así como en torniquetes e pinzas arteriais para parar o fluxo sanguíneo.
eng_text: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Ao longos de moitos séculos, o imperio romano alcanzou grandes logros no campo da medicina e deulle forma a moitos dos nosos coñecementos actuais.
eng_text: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: A papiroflexia pureland é un tipo particular coa restrición de que só se pode facer unha pregadura de cada vez, as pregaduras máis complexas como as inversas non están permitidas e todas deben ter localizacións directas.
eng_text: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Foi creado por John Smith na década os anos 70 para axudar ás persoas con pouca experiencia ou aos que tiñan habilidades motoras reducidas.
eng_text: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: A rapazada desenvolve a conciencia de raza e estereotipos raciais cando son moi novos e eses estereotipos raciais afectan o seu comportamento.
eng_text: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Por exemplo, os rapaces que se identifican cunha minoría racial estereotipada que non rende ben na escola tamén adoitan obter malos resultados na escola en canto son conscientes dese estereotipo que está asociado á súa raza.
eng_text: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace é o sitio web máis popular nos EE. UU. que, na actualidade, conta con 54 millóns de perfís.
eng_text: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Estes sitios web recibiron moita atención, especialmente no contexto educativo.
eng_text: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Eses sitios web teñen aspectos positivos entre os que se pode incluír a posibilidade de configurar facilmente unha páxina tipo que con blogs, vídeos, fotos e outras funcións.
eng_text: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Pódese acceder facilmente a esta páxina proporcionando simplemente un enderezo web, o que fai que resulte fácil de lembrar e de introducir para os estudantes que teñan dificultades para usar o teclado ou soletrear.
eng_text: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: É posible personalizala para facilitar a súa lectura e tamén darlle toda a cor que se desexe.
eng_text: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: O Trastorno de Déficit da Atención «é un síndrome neurolóxico definido por tres síntomas clásicos, incluída impulsividade, distracción e hiperactividade ou exceso de enerxía».
eng_text: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Non é unha discapacidade de aprendizaxe, é un trastorno da aprendizaxe, que «afecta a entre o 3 e o 5 % da poboación infantil, quizais preto de 2 millóns de rapaces estadounidenses».
eng_text: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: A rapazada con TDA ten dificultades para centrarse en cousas como as tarefas escolares, pero conseguen concentrarse en cousas que lles gustan, como xogar, ver os seus debuxos favoritos ou escribir frases sen puntuación.
eng_text: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Estes rapaces tenden a meterse en moitos problemas, porque «adoptan comportamentos perigosos, métense en liortas e desafían á autoridade» para estimular o seu cerebro, xa que este non é estimulado por medios normais.
eng_text: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: O TDA afecta ás relacións con outros iguais, porque a resto da rapazada non comprende por que se comportan así nin por que escriben dese xeito, así como tampouco que o seu nivel de madurez é diferente.
eng_text: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Como a habilidade para obter coñecementos e aprender cambiou da maneira que se indicou antes, a ratio base coa que se obtiñan os coñecementos tamén cambiou.
eng_text: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: O método para obter información era diferente. A peso xa non recaía na memoria do individuo para recordar, senón que a habilidade para recordar o texto converteuse no foco máis relevante.
eng_text: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Basicamente, o Renacemento produciu un cambio significativo no enfoque sobre a aprendizaxe e a difusión do coñecemento.
eng_text: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Ao contrario do que outros primates, os homínidos xa non usan as mans para desprazarse, sustentar o seu peso nin balancearse dunha árbore a outra.
eng_text: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: A man e o pé do chimpancé son moi similares en tamaño e forza, o que demostra o uso da man para cargar o peso ao camiñar sobre os cotelos.
eng_text: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: A man humana é máis curta que o pé, con falanxes máis rectas.
eng_text: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Os ósos fosilizados da man de hai dous ou tres millóns de anos revelan este cambio na súa especialización que pasou da locomoción á manipulación.
eng_text: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Algunhas persoas son da opinión de que ter moitos soños lúcidos inducidos de xeito artificial moi a miúdo pode resultar esgotador.
eng_text: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: A principal causa deste fenómeno é o resultado de que os soños lúcidos se estendan durante un período de tempo entre os estados REM.
eng_text: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Con menos REM por noite, ese estado no que se experimenta o sono real e o corpo se recupera, vólvese o suficientemente infrecuente como para converterse nun problema.
eng_text: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Isto resulta igual de esgotador que se un espertase cada vinte ou trinta minutos e se puxese a ver a televisión.
eng_text: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Este efecto dependerá da frecuencia coa que o cerebro trate de acadar o soño lúcido cada noite.
eng_text: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: As cousas non lles foron ben aos italianos no norte de África case desde o comezo. Ao cabo dunha semana da declaración de guerra de Italia, o 10 de xuño de 1940, o 11.º rexemento dos Húsares británicos xa capturara o Forte Capuzzo en Libia.
eng_text: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Nunha emboscada ao leste de Bardia, os británicos capturaron ao xeneral Lastucci, o enxeñeiro xefe do Décimo Exército italiano.
eng_text: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: O 28 de xuño, Marshal Italo Balbo, o gobernador xeral de Libia e claro herdeiro de Mussolini, foi asasinado por fogo amigo cando aterraba en Tobruk.
eng_text: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: A esgrima, como deporte moderno, xógase en diversos niveis, desde estudantes que están aprendendo na universidade ata en competición olímpica.
eng_text: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: O deporte xógase fundamentalmente en forma de duelo, cun esgrimidor loitando contra outro.
eng_text: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: O golf é un xogo no que os xogadores usan paus para golpear as bólas e metelas en buratos.
eng_text: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Nunha ronda normal xóganse 18 buratos, na que os xogadores normalmente empezan no primeiro burato do percorrido e rematan no dezaoito.
eng_text: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: O xogador que efectúa menor número de golpes ou swings co pao para finalizar o percorrido gaña.
eng_text: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: O xogo execútase sobre a herba e a que se atopa arredor do burato córtase máis baixa; o campo de xogo chámase «green» en inglés.
eng_text: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Tal vez o tipo de turismo máis común é o que a maioría das persoas asocia a viaxar: turismo recreativo.
eng_text: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Acontece cando as persoas van a un lugar diferente da súa vida cotiá habitual para relaxarse e divertirse.
eng_text: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: As praias, os parques temáticos e os cámpings son con frecuencia os lugares máis comúns frecuentados polos turistas.
eng_text: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Cando o obxectivo dunha visita a un lugar determinado ten como finalidade comprender a súa historia e cultura, este tipo de turismo denomínase cultural.
eng_text: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Os turistas poden visitar diferentes lugares de interese dun país en particular ou poden optar por centrarse nunha zona en particular.
eng_text: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Os colonos, en vista desa actividade, tamén solicitaron reforzos.
eng_text: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: As tropas que reforzaron as posicións de avance incluían o 1.º e 3.º rexemento de New Hampshire con 200 homes, comandados polos coroneis John Stark e James Reed (que posteriormente chegaron a xenerais).
eng_text: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Os homes de Stark tomaron posición ao longo do valado no extremo norte da posición dos colonos.
eng_text: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Cando a baixada da marea abriu un espazo ao longo do río Mystic ao noroeste da península, ampliaron deseguida o valado cun muro de pedra baixo cara ao norte que terminaba á beira da auga nunha pequena praia.
eng_text: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gridley ou Stark colocaron un poste a uns 30 m (100 pés) diante da cancela e ordenaron que ningún disparase ata que pasasen o exército profesional.
eng_text: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: O plan americano dependía do lanzamento de ataques coordinados desde tres direccións diferentes.
eng_text: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: O xeneral John Cadwalder lanzou un ataque de distracción contra a gornición británica en Bordentown co obxectivo de bloquear a chegada de reforzos.
eng_text: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: O xeneral James Ewing cruzou con 700 milicianos o río en Trenton Ferry, capturou a ponte sobre Assunpink Creek e evitou que as tropas inimigas fuxisen.
eng_text: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: A primeira forza de asalto de 2400 homes cruzou o río nove millas ao norte de Trenton para, a continuación, dividirse en dous grupos, un comandado por Greene e o outro por Sullivan, co obxectivo de lanzar un ataque antes do amencer.
eng_text: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Ao pasar da carreira dun cuarto de milla á media milla, a velocidade convértese en algo moito menos importante e a resistencia pasa a ser unha necesidade absoluta.
eng_text: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Por suposto, un corredor de media milla de primeira categoría, unha persoa que poida baixar de dous minutos, deberá posuír bastante nivel de velocidade, aínda que a resistencia deberá cultivarse a toda costa.
eng_text: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: As carreiras campo a través na estación invernal, xunto co traballo realizado no ximnasio para a parte superior do corpo, resultan o mellor adestramento para a tempada de carreiras.
eng_text: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Unhas prácticas nutricionais adecuadas soamente non poden dar lugar a rendementos de elite, aínda que si poden afectar de maneira importante ao benestar xeral dos xoves atletas.
eng_text: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Se se mantén un equilibrio de enerxía saudable, hábitos de hidratación efectivos e se comprenden os diferentes aspectos das prácticas de suplementos podemos axudar aos atletas a mellorar o seu rendemento e facer que gocen máis do deporte.
eng_text: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: As carreiras de media distancia constitúen un deporte relativamente económico; non obstante, existen moitas ideas falsas sobre as poucas pezas de equipamento necesarias para participar.
eng_text: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Os produtos poden mercarse segundo se necesiten, pero a maioría terán pouco ou ningún impacto real no rendemento.
eng_text: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: É posible que os atletas prefiran un produto aínda que este non lles proporcione ningún beneficio real.
eng_text: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: O átomo pódese considerar un dos bloques de construción básicos de toda a materia.
eng_text: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: É unha entidade moi complexa que consiste, segundo un modelo Bohr simplificado, dun núcleo central cunha órbita de electróns, en certa medida similar aos planetas que xiran arredor do sol (véxase a Figura 1.1).
eng_text: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: O núcleo componse de dúas partículas: neutróns e protóns.
eng_text: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Os protóns teñen unha carga eléctrica positiva mentres que os neutróns non teñen carga. Os electróns teñen carga eléctrica negativa.
eng_text: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Para comprobar o estado da vítima, primeiro debe avaliarse o lugar co fin de garantir a seguridade propia.
eng_text: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Débese prestar atención á posición da vítima ao achegarse a el ou ela e calquera sinal automático de alerta.
eng_text: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Se recibe unha lesión tratando de axudar, só estará a empeorar a situación.
eng_text: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: O estudo revelou que a depresión, o medo e a catastrofización media a relación entre a dor e a discapacidade nas persoas que padecen dor baixa de costas.
eng_text: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Só os efectos de facer unha catástrofe, non a depresión nin o medo, foron condicionais nas sesións periódicas semanais de consello práctico estruturadas.
eng_text: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Os que participan en actividades periódicas precisaron máis apoio en termos de percepción negativa da dor, facendo unha distinción das diferenzas entre dor crónica e sensación de malestar polo movemento físico normal.
eng_text: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: A visión ou a habilidade para ver depende dos órganos sensoriais do sistema visual ou ollos.
eng_text: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Existen moitas construcións de ollos distintas, cuxa complexidade varía segundo os requisitos do organismo.
eng_text: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: As diferentes construcións teñen diferentes capacidades, son sensibles a diferentes lonxitudes de onda e teñen diferentes graos de acuidade; ademais, requiren diferentes procesamentos para interpretar a información de entrada e os diferentes números co fin de funcionar de xeito óptimo.
eng_text: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Unha poboación é un conxunto de organismos dunha especie particular nunha área xeográfica determinada.
eng_text: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Cando todos os individuos dunha poboación son idénticos en relación a un trazo fenotípico particular, coñécense como monomórficos.
eng_text: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Cando os individuos amosan múltiples variantes dun trazo particular, son polimórficos.
eng_text: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Os exércitos das colonias de formigas tamén marchan e aniñan en diferentes fases.
eng_text: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Na fase nómade, as formigas lexionarias marchan durante a noite e paran para montar campaña durante o día.
eng_text: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: A colonia inicia unha fase nómade cando os alimentos dispoñibles diminúen. Durante esta fase, a colonia crea niños temporais que cambian a diario.
eng_text: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Cada un deses saqueos ou marchas nómades dura aproximadamente 17 días.
eng_text: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Que é unha célula? A palabra célula vén da palabra latina «cella», que significa «cuarto pequeno» e foi acuñada por primeira vez por un experto en microscopios que observaba a estrutura dunha cortiza.
eng_text: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: A célula é a unidade básica de todos os seres vivos e todos os organismos se compoñen dunha ou máis células.
eng_text: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: As células resultan fundamentais e críticas para o estudo da vida; de feito, con frecuencia denomínanse «as unidades básicas da vida».
eng_text: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: O sistema nervioso mantén a homeóstase ao enviar impulsos nerviosos a través do corpo para manter activo pero inalterado o fluxo de sangue.
eng_text: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Estes impulsos nerviosos poden enviarse tan rapidamente a través do corpo, que axuda a mantelo seguro fronte a calquera posible ameaza.
eng_text: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Os tornados afectan áreas reducidas en comparación con outras tormentas violentas, pero poden destruír todo o que se cruza no seu camiño.
eng_text: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Os tornados arrincan árbores, rachan seccións de edificios e fan voar coches ata o ceo. O 2 % dos tornados máis violentos duran máis de tres horas.
eng_text: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Estes trebóns monstruosos presentan ventos de ata 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
eng_text: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Os humanos fabrican e usan lentes de aumento durante desde hai milleiros e milleiros de anos.
eng_text: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Con todo, os primeiros telescopios fiables producíronse en Europa contra finais do século XVI.
eng_text: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Estes telescopios utilizaban unha combinación de dúas lentes para que os obxectos afastados parecesen máis próximos e grandes.
eng_text: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: A avaricia e o egoísmo sempre estarán connosco e é propio da natureza da cooperación que cando a maioría se ve beneficiada, sempre se obterá unha maior ganancia a curto prazo se se actúa de xeito egoísta.
eng_text: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Esperemos que a maioría das persoas se dean conta de que a súa mellor opción a longo prazo é colaborar cos demais.
eng_text: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Moitas persoas soñan co día no que os humanos poidan viaxar a outra estrela e explorar outros mundos; algúns pregúntanse que hai aí fora; outros cren que os extraterrestres ou outras formas de vida poden existir noutros planetas.
